programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc:
Martyna Wojciechowska once again sets out on a fascinating journey to learn about different aspects of the lives of women living in distant corners of the world.Some of the points of the route in this edition will be India, Senegal, South Korea, South Africa, Israel and Mexico.The program participants will talk about their everyday lives and reveal intimate secrets to the traveler.Some of them will be truly moving.This season, the journalist will look at how the Orthodox Jewish community functions on a daily basis and how they celebrate the joyful holiday of Purim.He will visit a nursing home for women who were once involved in prostitution.Although this profession is legal in Mexico, women are not entitled to any benefits.The traveler will also meet teenage Karolina, who works almost 24 hours a day at a garbage dump, and in South Africa she will meet a girl who dives with sharks.These are just some of the many amazing experiences that await Martyna Wojciechowska
Kinnar have been present in Indian culture for four thousand years.They are called divine dancers.These half-people, half-birds appear in Hindu mythology and Buddhism.Eunuchs often ensured the safety of wives in the courts of Indian rulers.Nowadays, recently married couples and parents of newborn children seek their blessing.On the one hand, the Kinnar are revered during religious and spiritual ceremonies, but on the other hand, they are cursed and discriminated against.Martyna Wojciechowska visits Ram Kali, which runs a non-governmental organization that provides support to the Kinnar community and fights for their rights.

Martyna Wojciechowska visits Lebanon to meet Ghada.In Syria she was involved in teaching.She hid from her husband and in-laws that she was studying, because in this country women's independence is not welcome.After the outbreak of the war, she became a social activist for representatives of her gender and children.He has been living in Lebanon for four years.He is already building a second school for young Syrians there.Her students had to leave their homeland before the war.Ghada founded the Damma organization and helps women find their way in new realities.Most of them support their families on their own.They also need integration and joint action.The heroine of the episode teaches Syrian women independence and gives them hope for a better tomorrow.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: On August 4, 2020, a powerful explosion occurred in the capital of Lebanon, Beirut.Almost 200 people died, thousands were injured, and 300,000 city residents lost their homes.The tragedy was caused by the explosion of 2,750 tons of domestic saltpeter, previously confiscated and stored in the port.A small Middle Eastern country - which has been struggling for years with the economic crisis, corruption, poverty and unemployment, and the problem of Syrian refugees - was unable to cope with the enormity of the destruction left after the explosion.The whole world supported him, but many months passed before the city was rebuilt.One of the people who supported the injured was volunteer Zena Chahine.She is the first woman in the Lebanese volunteer fire brigade.Following her example, dozens of other brave ladies entered the service.To this day, ignoring the danger, he does everything to rebuild his beloved city.

programs.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programs.desc: Another spice grown in Zanzibar is pepper.Amir, a farmer, will guide the camera around his plantation.He will explain how to plant and care for different types of pepper.Pascal will also visit Darajani Market, where you can buy vegetables, fruits and other products typical of this region.The master chef will also go fishing with the local fisherman, Kombo, and then visit the fish market.Local chef Ashi will help Pascal prepare a unique dish.In addition, the host will prepare a Polish-Zanzibar dish, i.e. sweet potato puree with coconut milk and pork tenderloin with colorful pepper.

programs.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programs.desc: During another culinary journey, Pascal Brodnicki learns the secrets of Zanzibar's cuisine.He tastes local delicacies, visits markets and places where local food is produced.

programs.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programs.desc: Master chef Pascal Brodnicki shows viewers how to replace traditional dishes with Asian dishes.It proves that preparing an original dinner is simple and does not have to cost much.In search of culinary inspiration, he goes to Vietnam, Laos and Thailand.He shops at local markets, prepares and sells snacks on the street, and works on a rice plantation.To prove himself, he prepares exotic dishes for his Asian hosts.He tries grilled gecko and baked ant larvae, and accepts an invitation to an unusual hunt.
